# VisionRestore Agent — Community Health Files

This folder defines how contributors and users interact with the project.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md` | Report a reproducible bug |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md` | Propose an enhancement |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/new_model_worker.md` | Add a new model worker |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/question.md` | Ask a usage question |
| `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | Open a pull request |

## Triage labels

- `bug` — confirmed or suspected defect
- `enhancement` — new feature or improvement
- `model-worker` — adds or changes a model integration
- `documentation` — docs only
- `question` — usage question
- `needs-triage` — needs maintainer attention
- `wontfix` — will not be addressed (with reason)
- `duplicate` — already tracked elsewhere
